restoration_note: This teaching articulates the Lord's going-forth at three named registers — gods, rich-ones, angels — each summoned by the one above, with all three reckoned ultimately to three of the Five Great Greatnesses (Living Spirit, Beloved of Lights, Third Ambassador). Restoration was strongly constrained by: (1) repeated formulaic openings (ⲛⲉⲧⲟⲩⲙⲟⲩⲧⲉ ⲁⲣⲁⲩ ⲭⲉ X ⲡⲉ ⲛ̄ⲧⲱϩⲙⲉ...), which fixed gaps 9, 15, 19, 20; (2) the recurring locator 'in the land of light, with no measure', which controlled gap 6 and confirmed the partial at gap 12; (3) the triadic 'house of X' structure that closes each appellation, which together with the visible -ⲥⲃⲉⲩⲧⲏⲥ in §3093 fixed gap 22 as the Third Ambassador. Word-splits across segment boundaries (gaps 3, 12, 15, 17, 21) reduced to mechanical completion. The single moderate-confidence stretch is gap 11, where the temporal clause's verb-and-subject must reference the Father's prior summoning to motivate 'they themselves made a calling' that follows; this is structurally necessary but not letter-fixed.
